headline: Advent Partnership to accelerate expansion; unlock next phase of growth

Advent-funded acquisitions to scale the network to 7,000-8,000 beds: YATHARTH intends to deploy Advent's capital towards acquiring operational, EBITDA-positive established hospital chains with a focus on North India, particularly Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab and Delhi-NCR, while also evaluating opportunities in other attractive regions.
The company is specifically targeting assets with higher ARPOBs and a greater share of cash and private insurance patients than its current platform.
The management expects the investment to support an incremental addition of 2,000–3,000 beds, taking the total network towards 7000–8000 beds in the next 3–4 years.
